## Problem

Describe the missing information, incorrect behavior, or tooling gap this change addresses.

## Change

Explain what a reader or contributor can do after this change.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include any checks that failed or were not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff contains one focused improvement.
- [ ] Relative links point to files included in this PR or already present on the base branch.
- [ ] Statements about completed merges or visible achievements have a dated source.
- [ ] Author and co-author metadata describe the actual contribution.

## Related work

Link a related issue or PR when applicable, and explain any overlap or dependency.
